items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins. Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins. >> [SPEAKER_05] That's the band here. That's the band here. Erskine Hawkins.

ctx.x: But, he's been in New York for a very long time. You know, as a young fellow. He's done very well. He was with, um, whose name was that? The same thing Mary's husband was with. His last name starts with an H. Not Heinz. Let's see.
Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins. Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins.
That's the band here. That's the band here. Erskine Hawkins.
